info.name: Restful-Booker-Proof
info.description: Stage 2 tooling proof against the public Restful-Booker demo API. Request and assertion IDs trace to the project test matrix naming style. See PROOF-NOTES.md for observations and live-run limits.

exec: pm.test('P-HEALTH-01: ping returns observed 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('P-HEALTH-02: ping body is Created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Created'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-01: ping Content-Type is text/plain', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/plain'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-02: ping responds under generous 10000 ms cold-start ceiling', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000); });

item.name: P-AUTH-01: valid credentials issue a token

exec: pm.test('P-AUTH-01: valid auth returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const authBody = pm.response.json();
pm.test('P-AUTH-02: response contains a token', function () { pm.expect(authBody.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.environment.set('token', authBody.token);
pm.test('P-QUAL-03: auth response is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-04: auth responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: P-AUTH-03: wrong credentials return observed body

exec: pm.test('P-AUTH-03: invalid credentials return observed 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('P-AUTH-04: invalid credentials return exact reason', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ reason: 'Bad credentials' }); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-05: invalid auth responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: P-CRUD-01: create booking and save booking_id

exec: const proofRunKey = Date.now().toString() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000).toString();
pm.environment.set('run_key', proofRunKey);
pm.environment.set('booking_firstname', 'ProofRunner' + proofRunKey);
pm.environment.set('booking_lastname', 'CollectionTest' + proofRunKey);
pm.test('P-CRUD-01: create returns documented 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const created = pm.response.json();
pm.test('P-CRUD-02: create returns bookingid and booking', function () { pm.expect(created.bookingid).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(created.booking).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.environment.set('booking_id', created.bookingid);
pm.test('P-QUAL-06: create response is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-07: create responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: P-CRUD-02: get booking ids filtered by unique names

exec: const ids = pm.response.json();
pm.test('P-CRUD-03: get all returns 200 and an array', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(ids).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-04: filtered list items have numeric booking ids', function () { pm.expect(ids.every(x => Number.isInteger(x.bookingid))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-08: booking list responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: P-CRUD-03: get created booking and verify submitted fields

exec: const booking = pm.response.json();
pm.test('P-CRUD-05: get created booking returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('P-CRUD-06: get booking fields match create request', function () { pm.expect(booking.firstname).to.eql(pm.environment.get('booking_firstname')); pm.expect(booking.lastname).to.eql(pm.environment.get('booking_lastname')); pm.expect(booking.totalprice).to.eql(321); pm.expect(booking.depositpaid).to.eql(true); pm.expect(booking.bookingdates).to.eql({ checkin: '2026-12-01', checkout: '2026-12-05' }); pm.expect(booking.additionalneeds).to.eql('Breakfast'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-09: booking response is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-10: get booking responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: P-CRUD-04: full update requires token cookie

exec: pm.test('P-CRUD-07: full update returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-08: full update returns updated booking', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql('Proof Updated'); pm.expect(b.totalprice).to.eql(654); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-11: PUT response is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-12: PUT responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: P-CRUD-05: GET verifies full update persisted

exec: const b = pm.response.json();
pm.test('P-CRUD-09: updated booking returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('P-CRUD-10: PUT values persisted', function () { pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql('Proof Updated'); pm.expect(b.totalprice).to.eql(654); pm.expect(b.depositpaid).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.additionalneeds).to.eql('Lunch'); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-11: PATCH returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-12: PATCH returns the changed field', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().additionalneeds).to.eql('Dinner'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-13: PATCH responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-13: delete returns documented 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-14: delete response is Created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Created'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-14: DELETE responds under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-15: deleted booking returns 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('P-CRUD-16: deleted booking body is Not Found', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Not Found'); });
pm.test('P-NEG-01: non-existent booking returns 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('P-NEG-02: non-existent GET body is Not Found', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Not Found'); });
pm.test('P-NEG-03: unauthenticated PUT returns observed 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('P-NEG-04: unauthenticated PUT body is Forbidden', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Forbidden'); });
pm.test('P-NEG-05: unauthenticated DELETE returns observed 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('P-NEG-06: unauthenticated DELETE body is Forbidden', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Forbidden'); });
pm.test('P-NEG-07: authenticated DELETE non-existent returns observed 405', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(405); });
pm.test('P-NEG-08: authenticated DELETE non-existent body is Method Not Allowed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Method Not Allowed'); });
pm.test('P-NEG-09: missing booking fields return observed 500', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(500); });
pm.test('P-NEG-10: missing booking fields body is Internal Server Error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Internal Server Error'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-15: schema fixture create returns documented 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const q = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('quality_booking_id', q.bookingid);
pm.test('P-QUAL-16: schema fixture has booking object', function () { pm.expect(q.booking).to.be.an('object'); });

item.name: P-QUAL-17: validate booking response with tv4 schema

exec: var bookingSchema = { type: 'object', required: ['firstname','lastname','totalprice','depositpaid','bookingdates'], properties: { firstname: { type: 'string' }, lastname: { type: 'string' }, totalprice: { type: 'number' }, depositpaid: { type: 'boolean' }, bookingdates: { type: 'object', required: ['checkin','checkout'], properties: { checkin: { type: 'string' }, checkout: { type: 'string' } } }, additionalneeds: { type: 'string' } } };
var schemaResponse = pm.response.json();
pm.test('P-QUAL-17: schema fixture GET returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-18: booking validates against JSON schema via tv4', function () { pm.expect(tv4.validate(schemaResponse, bookingSchema), JSON.stringify(tv4.error)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-19: schema response Content-Type is JSON', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-20: schema response under 1000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-21: schema fixture cleanup returns documented 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('P-QUAL-22: schema fixture cleanup body is Created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Created'); });
